title: Changes in Corneal Morphology and Biomechanics in Cases of Small Incision Lenticule Extraction with Prophylactic Accelerated Collagen Cross-Linking

indication: myopia with or without astigmatism in eyes at moderate-to-high risk of ectasia (Randleman score); established or forme fruste keratoconus, hyperopia and mixed astigmatism excluded

groups.description: SMILE (VisuMax 500 kHz) with prophylactic accelerated CXL through the pocket (0.22% riboflavin, UVA 30 mW/cm2 for 90 s); 28 eyes of 14 patients

exclusions.reason: preoperative values of the eyes seen at each visit; no follow-up values per subset

exclusions.what: Proportions within ±0.50 and ±1.00 D of target (Results, Fig. 2)

notes: Single-arm series: every eye had prophylactic accelerated CXL in addition to SMILE, so the group is recorded treated.
Target plano: Methods state that the refractive target was to achieve emmetropia.

Selection criteria included abnormal preoperative topography (asymmetric bowtie, inferior steepening, skewed radial axis, central keratometry 48.0 D or more); established and forme fruste keratoconus were excluded.
Attrition is ordinary loss to follow-up, not outcome-defined; later means cover fewer eyes.
Visual acuity, keratometry, topographic indices, elevations, pachymetry and biomechanics are tabulated but not extracted.

series.notes: mean ± SD; eyes seen 28, 28, 26, 22, 12 and 10 at preoperative, 1 day, 1, 3, 6 and 12 months (loss to follow-up)
